lead_raw_text:
The structure of YbCu crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing four atoms (Yb2Cu2) distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Cu and Yb centers have 12 geometric neighbors each, forming close-packed-like local arrangements: Cu is surrounded by 8 Cu and 4 Yb, while Yb has 12 Cu neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.82 to 3.02 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all four sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the 12-vertex Cu and Yb coordination polyhedra.
